title: AI Innovation Showcase
location: 15 Customs Street West, Auckland CBD, Auckland 1010, Auckland
description:
**Kia ora dear members!**

The Auckland AWS Tools and Programming user group invites you to a special October meetup spotlighting the next generation of cloud and AI innovation from the University of Auckland.

This month, we are turning the spotlight onto real-world, high-impact generative AI and intelligent agents built in collaboration with AWS mentors. Join us for an exclusive live demonstration and technical breakdown from **Team S4Y** as they present their capstone project:

**HIMA - "*Say it once. Your farm runs.”***

Farmers spend their days out in the paddock, but logging data, updating plans, and managing compliance usually happens hours later across fragmented, isolated systems. Built specifically for New Zealand dairy farms, HIMA bridges this gap using an offline-first, voice-driven AI assistant.

**What HIMA does:**

* **Zero-Signal Voice Capture:** Farmers can speak a single sentence directly in the field—even with no mobile signal—and HIMA turns it into structured farm records the moment connectivity is restored.
* **Automated Compliance & Planning:** Transforms raw operational inputs into drafted daily schedules and regulatory compliance paperwork automatically.
* **Multi-Source Data Unification:** Integrates eight critical farm data streams—including livestock metrics, environmental conditions, and task tracking—combined with NZ-specific farming rules and domain expertise.
* **Agentic Workflows with Human-in-the-Loop:** Powered by **Amazon Bedrock** and **AgentCore**, HIMA safely coordinates complex operational actions while keeping the farmer firmly in control of every final decision.

### Why Attend?

* **Live Technical Demos:** See firsthand how students applied cutting-edge foundational models, multi-agent frameworks, and cloud architecture to solve practical challenges in New Zealand's primary sector.
* **AWS Architectural Insights:** Learn about the practical implementation details of orchestrating agents with Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore.

title: Build Night: Demos, Collabs & Open Source in Practice
description:
A fortnightly, hands-on session focused on the projects the Auckland AI Collective is actually building — together.

Each session centres on **demonstrations** of what members are working on. Expect live demos, group experiments, and the occasional "let's just try it and see what happens" moment — so come ready to get involved, not just watch. Some parts may invite your participation; none of it is polished or precious.

The tone is **casual and informal**\- eat dinner\, drink\, and enjoy\. This is a place to share ideas\, get feedback\, find collaborators\, and turn "someone should build that" into an actual repo\.

What we cover will vary week to week depending on what people bring and what the group is curious about — the constant is the room: builders comparing notes and starting things together.

**This is for you if** you want to get directly and personally involved in group projects, collaborations, and **open source**.

See what we're already building on GitHub: [https://github.com/auckland-ai-collective](https://github.com/auckland-ai-collective)

Bring a project, a problem, an idea, or just yourself.

After this session we can hang out as long as we like at the restaurant if you want to keep the conversation going and connect with other professionals.

title: JuniorDev Auckland Meet
location: 125 The Strand, Parnell, Auckland 1010, New Zealand, Auckland
description:
We’re happy to announce the next **JuniorDev Auckland event**!

Join us for an evening of learning and connection as we hear from our speakers and the experiences they’ll be sharing.

**Important Note for Attendees:**

* **Please note of the new location for the event: [Directions to Serko House](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1M8Jt_-5DmBABSiNnaDpCpNiHNfxMRCICI1eRBjne-08/edit?tab=t.0) (Just 2 mins away from Xero)**

**Talk 1: Finding Joy After AI: An Inside Out Look at How We Work by Kevin Meneses**
Inspired by Disney and Pixar's Inside Out films, this (pre-recorded) talk uses their premise as a framework to explore what team survey data reveals about AI adoption, productivity, and working hours, offering practical ways to thrive in an AI-assisted workflow.

**A bit about Kevin:**

* Kevin is a Junior Software Engineer at Fergus who transitioned into engineering from the Customer Support team after completing a full stack developer programme.

**Talk 2: Building AI without Losing Our Values by**
**Lauren Peate**
AI is here to stay – hype, copyright theft, data worker mistreatment, environmental harm, and all. If you care about people and the planet but also need to understand new tech, what can you do? I’ll recommend a middle ground – using AI in features and workflows without compromising our values. Combining my own experience with insights from our original research with hundreds of global developers, I’ll share examples of how to use this tech with care.

**A bit about Lauren:**

* Lauren Peate is a data nerd who cares about people. She’s founder and CEO of Multitudes, which turns engineering metrics into a tool for continuous improvement – in AI, engineering productivity, developer experience, and more. Through her career, she’s worked with a wide range of organizations, from Fortune 500 tech companies in San Francisco to startups in the Middle East. Previously on a PhD track, she started her career conducting independent research through a Fulbright grant.

title: Brand It, Fix It, Sort It, Ship It: AI for Real Business Problems
description:
Most people use AI to answer questions. Power users use it to get work done: the branding, research, site changes and busywork that normally means hiring someone or learning a new skill.

This is a live demo and discussion session on using AI tools effectively to solve real business problems. We’ll build things on screen, show what’s worth doing with AI today, and talk about how to get the same results in your own work. Bring the tools you already use and the problems you deal with day-to-day.

We’ll explore:

* Branding a business from scratch. Take one idea all the way through naming, positioning, logo and domain name research, live, in a single sitting.
* Modifying a live website, to make it work better for you. Create a user script that enhances a site you don’t control, and keep the improvement for future visits.
* Delegating whole jobs. Why giving AI a complete task gets better results than asking it questions, and how to brief it.
* Where AI pays off. How to spot the work in your week worth handing off, and how to tell whether it helped.
* Knowing when to step in. Where AI output needs a human check, and how to test its work before you rely on it.

No prior background assumed. If you run a business, lead a team, or just keep running into tasks you don’t know how to do, this is for you.

Afterwards we usually continue over dinner nearby, a good chance to connect with fellow builders and practitioners.
